Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {2}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Hangarback Walker resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.

206-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
206-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2174-3525-8328.easyPrerequisites:

Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.

Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat from step 1

151-304-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-304-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.

Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5223-5741-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1818-2173-5010-8095.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-5010-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3188-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-3188-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1981-2415-3641.easyPrerequisites:

You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-3641.description:

957-2556-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-2556-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Mnemonic Wall without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Mnemonic Wall) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-2556-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

301-1099-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
301-1099-7804.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

670-745-1619-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1251-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1251-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1251-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Marionette Master
Resolve the Marionette Master trigger, creating three artifact tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two artifacts, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-3121.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

206-222-527-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Atog by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

240-413-4785-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

Repeat step 2.

Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

729-1283-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
729-1283-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian.
Repeat.

101-372-1567.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

864-2104-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Eternal Witness each turn.
864-2104-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

117-185-2501-3098-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} on the first turn, with at most {3}{U} available each odd-numbered extra turn and {5}{U} each even-numbered extra turn
117-185-2501-3098-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
You control at least one Rogue that cannot be blocked by an opponent and that does not have summoning sickness.
117-185-2501-3098-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Notorious Throng's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Notorious Throng trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Notorious Throngs, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Notorious Throng.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Notorious Throng and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 7 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Notorious Throng.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Notorious Throng and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

567-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:

Your life total is at least 2.

Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

770-914-2499.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
770-914-2499.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

117-185-2501-3098-4872.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
117-185-2501-3098-4872.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-2501-3098-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Time Warp's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Time Warp trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Time Warps, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Time Warp.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Time Warp and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Time Warp.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Time Warp and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

262-508.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery attached to Black Carriage.
262-508.description:
During your upkeep, activate Black Carriage by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Black Carriage by paying {0} and sacrificing an Elemental token, untapping Black Carriage.
Repeat.
